description: The following description is about the account payable process. It begins when you submit to the vendor accounting department. When the transfer to the vendor accounting department is complete, a Receiving Report must be created. After creating a receiving report, the process is split into 2 parallel branches : reporting errors to the relevant team member and doubling a three-way match. Once the problem has been reported to a member of the relevant team, you need to confirm that all documents have been amended. Once all pre-tasks have been completed, then you must check the dates to avoid penalties. The process is now complete.
